# Vorax Labs

> Vorax Labs makes supplements for men who read the label. Its product on the market is L-Citrulline Enhanced, a lemon-flavored powder with 6,000 mg of pure L-citrulline per 10 g serving and every ingredient listed with its exact amount and form. Enclomax 7 is a prescription-only capsule that is still in development and is not for sale. The site is available in English and Spanish.

## Products
- [L-Citrulline Enhanced](https://voraxlabs.com/en/products/l-citrulline-enhanced/): 300 g, lemon, 30 servings. Supplement Facts per 10 g serving: pure L-citrulline 6,000 mg, L-arginine alpha-ketoglutarate (AAKG) 1,000 mg, black maca extract 10:1 1,000 mg, beetroot extract (6% nitrates) 500 mg, AstraGin 25 mg, zinc (picolinate) 20 mg, boron (citrate) 10 mg, vitamin B6 (P-5-P) 10 mg, BioPerine 10 mg, vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin) 1,000 mcg.
- [Enclomax 7](https://voraxlabs.com/en/products/enclomax-7/): prescription only, in development, to be dispensed through licensed clinics after medical evaluation and lab work. Not a dietary supplement and not sold directly.
- [All products](https://voraxlabs.com/en/products/)

## Company
- [The formula](https://voraxlabs.com/en/formula/): what each ingredient of L-Citrulline Enhanced does and why pure L-citrulline is used instead of citrulline malate.
- [Quality](https://voraxlabs.com/en/quality/): manufacturer and standards.
- [Where to buy](https://voraxlabs.com/en/where-to-buy/): authorized distributors. Exclusive distributor in Peru: Prime Supplements Perú (https://primesupplementsperu.com).
- [Wholesale](https://voraxlabs.com/en/wholesale/): how to apply to become a distributor.
